security_status.rls: Enabled on all major tables, including clinics

security_status.ai_safety: Multi-layer protection: Zod Validation + Prompt Delimiters + JSON Schema + Output Validation

api_endpoints.description: Tra cứu liều dùng thuốc bằng AI với bảo mật chống Prompt Injection.
api_endpoints.security: Zod Validation, Gemini JSON Schema, Auth Required

gotchas.issue: AI Prompt Injection via User Input
gotchas.solution: Use Zod regex to restrict characters, wrap input in '---' delimiters, and reinforce system instructions in the prompt.
Enable 'response_mime_type: application/json' and provide 'response_schema' in Gemini config to guarantee structured output.
